plain: A woman taking photos at sunset on a beach in Baja California, Mexico, is said to have caught a being in a suit in one of her pictures. Ammar Kandil, a guest presented as holding a large store of UFO evidence, tells Michels the story at several removes: it came from 'my best friend's sister's best friend.' He brings it up because it reminded him of another account.
